derivation: from the same as H2191 (זְעֵיר)xlit zeʻêyr corrected to zᵉʻêyr;
def: fewness; by implication, as superl. diminutiveness

words.word: is it not yet a very

occurrences.text: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
